description: We're a fun and friendly club, always open to new members, whether you've been playing for years or have never heard of Korfball before! We train as a whole club on Tuesday evenings, and also host regular socials. We have 5 teams of different abilities, so players at all levels have the opportunity to play matches.
sessions.title: Whole Club Tuesday Training
sessions.meetingPoint: Didsbury High School, 4 The Avenue, Didsbury
sessions.specialConsiderations: There is plenty of parking and it is across the road from Withington tram stop.

name: Try Tag Rugby Salford
participatingLeagues.name: Try Tag Rugby Leagues
description: Try Tag Rugby Salford offers fun, inclusive and social mixed-gender tag rugby leagues for adults aged 18+ across Salford and East Manchester. The game is suitable for beginner or experienced players and everyone is welcome! Our friendly leagues are a great way to get active, meet new people and enjoy being part of a community. We offer free taster sessions so you can give tag rugby a go before committing. No experience necessary, just come along and give it a try!
additionalInformation:
All welcome. Come down and give it a try!

Taster sessions are FREE. Contact the club for regular pricing. The cost to join a league can be found on our website and varies between each league.
sessions.title: East Manchester League
sessions.meetingPoint: East Manchester Academy, 60 Grey Mare Lane
sessions.specialConsiderations: Every Monday, with league games taking place weekly. There are no training sessions, so you can jump straight into playing! Kick-off times are 7pm, 7:40pm or 8:20pm, and your team will be allocated one of these slots each week.
